description: This file defines the CostOptimizationHubClient class which provides methods for interacting with the AWS Cost Optimization Hub service. It includes method annotations for various operations such as getPreferences, getRecommendation, listEnrollmentStatuses, and others, some of which have asynchronous counterparts. The class extends AwsClient, indicating that it is a specialized client for this AWS service.

classes.name: CostOptimizationHubClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with the AWS Cost Optimization Hub service, providing methods for retrieving and updating preferences, recommendations, and enrollment statuses.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves preferences related to cost optimization.

methods.name: getPreferencesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves preferences related to cost optimization.

methods.name: listEnrollmentStatuses
methods.description: Lists enrollment statuses for the cost optimization service.

methods.name: updateEnrollmentStatus
methods.description: Updates the enrollment status for the service.

methods.name: updatePreferences
methods.description: Updates preferences for the cost optimization service.
